title: Overhead Panel Wiring — Warning and Detection Annunciation Feeds

ata.title: Flight Compartment Wiring — Overhead Panel Wiring

abstract: Wiring sheet for the overhead panel runs that carry warning and detection annunciation, with the connector list at the panel hinge and the routing constraint across the hinge line.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the overhead panel wiring that carries warning and detection annunciation to the panel, with the connectors at the hinge and the equipment served.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn with the panel in the lowered position, which is how it is worked on, not in the flight position. Every run crossing the hinge line is shown with its service loop length; a loop shorter than the value stated will chafe within a few hundred panel movements. The detection annunciation runs are segregated from the warning runs across the hinge and must stay in their own bundle.
sections.routing_note: Runs leave the panel through the hinge trough and pass into the ceiling void at frame 12, supported at 200 millimetre intervals. The service loop at the hinge is 180 millimetres and must be re-formed, not pulled straight, whenever the panel is refitted.

type_data.sheet_title: OVERHEAD PANEL WIRING — WARNING AND DETECTION ANNUNCIATION
routes: Overhead panel hinge trough to ceiling void at frame 12, service loop 180 mm at the hinge
